about_the_game:
Note: The base game is required to play this map. Please ensure that your game is updated to the latest version.

Welcome to Dage Island!

Discover the newest addition to "Land of the Vikings" – Dage Island. This captivating map features rugged mountainous terrain and introduces new challenges like landslides.

Experience strategic depth and thrilling moments as you navigate the island's scattered resources and contend with natural disasters. The expansive Dage Island demands resourcefulness and resilience as you struggle to survive its harsh environment.
We hope this new map offers an unforgettable experience that you will enjoy!

short_description: Dage Island is a new map for "Land of the Vikings". The map is a new island with a mountainous terrain, providing players with new ways to build their Viking settlements.
